SIMPLE ENGLISH
Model represents domain/data and behavior, View presents information, Controller handles
input and coordinates responses. An API controller may return JSON instead of a rendered
View.

request එක අරJගන අදාළ වුJඩේ coordinate කරනවා.

A product search controller asks the model/service for matching products and passes them to a
view.

operations.

Q: Is MVC the same as three-tier deployment?
A: No. MVC is a separation of application responsibilities; tiers describe physical or deployment
boundaries.
